segment.source: Place application-owned buttons in the title bar LeftAddOn/RightAddOn areas using WindowTitleBarButton and WindowTitleBarToggleButton.
The left add-on hosts a menu button and a pin toggle; the right add-on hosts search and settings buttons.
The default Window shape: title, three caption buttons and standard interactions, as the baseline for other demos.
This is the default look of an AtomUI Window. The title bar shows the title together with the standard caption buttons.
Compose the caption button set: hide the minimize button and show the full screen and pin buttons.
Only full screen and pin buttons remain on the right of the title bar; minimizing is disabled for this window.
Customize TitleBarFrameBackground, ContentFrameBackground and a decorative WindowFrameLayer with opacity.
The title bar uses a gradient, the content area a brand tint, and a corner-decorated layer floats above them.

IsTitleVisible=False hides only the title text inside the title bar; the taskbar and window switching still show the OS window title. Different from IsTitleBarVisible, which hides the whole title bar.
The title bar shows no title text, but the taskbar still shows "AtomUI Demo".
Switch the Logo display policy between Auto, Always and Never.
Switch the segmented control below and watch the Logo visibility change.
Explore Window title bar content, window chrome and frame layer customization.
On macOS the system traffic lights are native: the minimize, maximize and full screen switches apply to the AtomUI-drawn buttons on Windows/Linux; only the pin switch takes effect here.
A live window combining every option on this page: title text, alignment, logo policy, add-ons, caption buttons and frame backgrounds.
The panel on the right acts on this window's title bar and frame in real time.
Switch the title group alignment between Auto, Left, Center, WindowCenter and Right.
Switch the segmented control below and watch the title group alignment change.
IsTitleBarVisible=False removes the built-in title bar; a custom header row and an embedded WindowTitleBar keep dragging and double-click maximize working.
The top area is fully custom. The embedded title bar still supports dragging and double-click to maximize.
